decisions.summary: Stockline's price rose to 0.03, but it is still the best option: 0.03 margin per check, data 5 s old, and 14 of 20 recent tries paid with no unavailable. Ridgeline is worse (0.05 price, 0.01 margin, 8 of 20 unavailable). I kept the current policy (Stockline, no cache, up to the 0.04 cap). I did not pay Northgate Stock: it is not in the supplier list, and its x402 offer is unverified. No purchases made.

Packwise Starter ends this month and Pro (45.00 EUR/month) is needed to keep warehouse sync. My 30.00 EUR per-purchase card limit blocks it, so I asked the CFO (P-0001) to raise the limit to 45.00 EUR. I will buy Pro once it is approved, before the month ends. Stock-check buying is unchanged: Stockline, up to the 0.04 cap, no cache; no purchases made this wake.

Ran dispute settlement for Summit Outfitters. Orders #11, #13 and #16 were refunded because the stock checks wrongly showed parkas in stock. Orders #12, #14 and #15 went to the CFO as P-0002 with advice to deny: the orders were signed and paid by Summit's own agent, and I found no error in them.

Planned Stockline invoice SLL-2026-11 (EUR 240.00, due 15 Nov) as P-0003: SWIFT, fee capped at 20.00, FX only for the EUR 160.00 shortfall (USD 180.29); it waits for the CFO's Face ID. No rebalance or sweep needed now — no agent is blocked and earnings are small.

I took no action this wake. The new payment of EUR 1,240.00 (NW-R-201, matched) gives us enough euros to pay the Stockline invoice SLL-2026-11 (EUR 240.00, due 15 Nov) without changing any money. But the plan already waiting, P-0003, still buys USD 180.29 worth of euros for a EUR 160.00 shortfall that no longer exists. Code won't plan the invoice again while P-0003 is waiting. If the CFO lets P-0003 expire or rejects it, I can plan it again without the currency exchange, and there's still time before 15 Nov. INV-2026-1043 is already paid. No agent is blocked by its mandate, and unswept earning
